confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from automated SQL injection attempts to a successful login from the same external IP, followed by privilege escalation, massive database queries, high-volume data exfiltration to a known malicious domain, and log tampering.

attack_chain.description: Automated SQL injection attempts using sqlmap from IP 104.244.76.13.
Successful login of user_02 from the same suspicious IP (104.244.76.13) during off-hours.
Privilege escalation where user_02 was elevated to 'dba' role.
Unauthorized database queries targeting the 'customers' table, affecting hundreds of thousands of rows.
Data exfiltration via DNS/UDP to a malicious domain (x9111.malicious-44.com).
Large volume data exfiltration via HTTPS (TCP 443) to an external destination.
Attempt to cover tracks by deleting/truncating the authentication log (/var/log/auth.log).

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_02's credentials were stolen via the initial SQL injection attempt.
Verification of the destination IP for the large TCP transfers to confirm if they match the malicious domain.
narrative: An attacker used SQL injection attempts from IP 104.244.76.13 to likely compromise user_02's credentials. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to DBA, queried massive amounts of customer data, exfiltrated approximately 241.7 MB of data to a malicious domain, and finally deleted authentication logs to hide the intrusion.
